subject: SIG: external services census and inventory — action plan
messages:
From: Diane Holloway <diane.holloway@acmehealth.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: SOC2-Audit <soc2@external-audit.com>
Date: 2026-01-25T14:05:00-08:00
Subject: SIG questionnaire: request for current external services census

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for working with us on the SIG intake for Acme Health. As part of the SIG review we need an up-to-date list of all external services and subprocessors that Redwood uses in production and for telemetry/observability. Please include: vendor name (legal entity), services used (e.g., S3, RDS, Datadog for metrics), whether the vendor processes customer data or telemetry, data types processed (PII/PHI/telemetry), geographic region of processing, retention, and contract/reference (PO/contract id if available).

Can you send a consolidated roster by Friday 2026-01-29? If you have a template, please send that — we can accept a consolidated parent org list but need the service-level details for cloud providers.

Also: please mark any vendors that process PHI specifically (we will flag those for additional controls).

Thanks,
Diane
Diane Holloway
Senior Information Security Analyst
Acme Health — Vendor Risk

[attachment: SIG-guidance.pdf (link)]

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: Diane Holloway <diane.holloway@acmehealth.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-01-26T09:13:00-08:00
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire: request for current external services census

Hi Diane —

Appreciate the clear ask. We're on it and will deliver a consolidated roster with service-level detail by the deadline (2026-01-29). I've looped in Neha (Vendor Risk) and Karthik (ops liaison) to pull inventory and verify contracts.

I'm attaching a simple template we usually use — please confirm that the columns below align with what you need; we can expand if necessary:
- legal_entity
- service_name
- service_type (cloud/storage/telemetry/support)
- processes_customer_data (yes/no)
- data_types
- regions_of_processing
- retention_policy
- contract_reference

Quick clarification question: for telemetry vendors (metrics/traces/logs), would you prefer a single "Telemetry" entry per vendor, or do you want each telemetry stream listed separately (e.g., Datadog-metrics, Datadog-logs)? Diane, if you prefer service-level granularity for cloud providers (S3 vs EFS) we can provide that.

Plan: Neha will circulate a preliminary CSV by EOD Tue (2026-01-27), we'll review internally Wed, and submit the final roster + short evidence pack (contracts/POs where available) by Fri.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Head of Trust & Security
Redwood Inference

[attachment: redwood_subprocessor_template.xlsx]

From: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-01-27T08:42:00-08:00
Subject: Fwd: SIG questionnaire: request for current external services census — preliminary roster attached

Marissa / Karthik — forwarding preliminary extraction from our asset registry. This is a quick dump and needs cleaning; I'm attaching a CSV. A few notes and questions inline.

[attachment: prelim_subprocessor_list.csv]

Preview (first rows):
- Amazon Web Services, Inc. | S3 | cloud storage | yes | backups, object storage | us-east-1, us-west-2 | 90 days | Contract: AWS-2024-045
- Amazon Web Services, Inc. | RDS (managed Postgres) | managed db | yes | customer data (db) | us-east-1 | 365 days | Contract: AWS-2024-045
- Datadog, Inc. | Datadog Metrics | telemetry | yes | metrics, infra telemetry | us-east-1 | 30 days | PO-3321
- Intercom, Inc. | Intercom | support/chat | maybe | user messages (customer support) | us-east-1 | 180 days | Contact: SalesRep

Questions for SIG:
1) AWS: do you want each AWS service as a separate line (S3, RDS, Lambda) or can we submit AWS (parent) + a service list column? Parent consolidation would reduce row count but Diane asked for service-level detail for cloud providers — I'm leaning to include service list in the same row as a CSV field.
2) Telemetry: for Datadog and Honeycomb we currently ingest logs + metrics + traces in different retention layers. Should we break these out per stream?

I'll start cleaning vendor names and mark PHI-handling systems (there are two internal integrations flagged).

- Neha Kapoor
Vendor Risk Manager
Redwood Inference

> Hi Diane —
>

From: Diane Holloway <diane.holloway@acmehealth.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: SOC2-Audit <soc2@external-audit.com>
Date: 2026-01-27T11:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire: request for current external services census

Hi Neha / Marissa —

Thanks for the preview and the helpful questions. Our guidance:
- Parent consolidation is acceptable provided you include a service-level column listing the specific cloud services used (e.g., AWS: S3, RDS, KMS).
- For telemetry vendors, please break out distinct data processing streams when they have different retention or access controls (e.g., Datadog-logs vs Datadog-metrics). If retention matches across streams, a single telemetry entry with a note is fine.
- Please explicitly flag any systems that process PHI. We'll need additional controls/evidence for those.

Attached is a short SIG guidance note and an example row. If you can incorporate the service-level list as a CSV cell (comma-separated) that works.

Link to SIG guidance: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3cSIG-inventory-template

If you can submit the cleaned roster and a short evidence packet (contracts or PO ids for the top 20 vendors) by 2026-01-29 EOD, that will keep us on track.

Thanks,
Diane

[attachment: SIG-guidance.pdf]

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: Diane Holloway <diane.holloway@acmehealth.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-01-29T09:17:00-08:00
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire: request for current external services census — action plan and deliverables

Diane —

Thanks for the clarifications. Final action plan and owners below; attached is a one-page evidence plan.

Deliverables (timeline):
- 2026-01-29 EOD: Final cleaned roster (CSV) including service-level lists per cloud provider + PHI flags — owner: Neha (attached).
- 2026-01-30 EOD: Evidence packet (contracts/POs for top 20 vendors) uploaded to shared drive — owner: Marissa (legal & procurement pulling docs).
- 2026-02-02: Follow-up Q&A with Acme security (30 min) to walk any flagged PHI items — owner: Marissa.

Notes:
- We will submit AWS as a parent row with a service_list column containing S3, RDS, KMS, Lambda, EKS.
- Telemetry vendors will be split by stream where retention/access differs (Datadog-logs, Datadog-metrics).
- PHI-handling integrations have been labeled in the roster and will have contract references pulled.

Attachments: sig_evidence_plan.pdf (one-page owner/timing matrix). We'll push the roster to the Drive link you provided and notify when evidence is uploaded.

Best,
Marissa Cole

Redwood Inference
